authority.note: Blessed the pupil master (top-left of the expression sheet) as the canonical hero. Drawn by the clawd-master SVG generator, not an image model.

invariants: It is the Anthropic pixel critter per reference/clawd/source/clawd-true-reference.png: a WIDE, SQUAT rectangular terracotta body, noticeably wider than it is tall.
Eyes are two TALL THIN VERTICAL BLACK BARS set high and wide on the face. Not squares, not dots, no white glints.
One flat rectangular STUB tab on each side of the body at mid-height, short and blunt.
FOUR short stubby rectangular legs below the body.
NO MOUTH. The whole expression lives in the eyes.
Flat single terracotta fill (#CC7A5C family) with a subtle slightly-darker outline. No gradient, no highlight band, no shading rows.
NO angel elements: no wings, no halo, no floating heart. Those are angel-clawd.
Transparent ground on every deliverable: shot on solid chroma-green and keyed; no baked background, no drop shadow on the final PNG.

registerNeutral.medium: flat pixel-sticker illustration: a cute designed-sticker take on a pixel mascot, crisp blocky shapes on a solid chroma ground (keyed to transparent for deliverables)
registerNeutral.why: Same recorded medium exception as angel-clawd (canon/craft/pixel-mascot-medium-exception.json): merch-facing mascot art. No register anchor and no register poles on its shots; identity comes from the canonical Clawd screenshot.

relativeTo.angel-clawd: identical size to (same critter, no wings)

prose.voice: Silent. He stands, he glints, he ships.
prose.lore: The plain Anthropic pixel critter, no angel elements: the base identity that angel-clawd is derived from. PRIMARY identity reference is Gary's clean screenshot of the canonical pixel Clawd (reference/angel-clawd/source/clawd-clean-screenshot.png), passed as the first input image on every shot. Rendered, like angel-clawd, as a charming designed-sticker reinterpretation via gpt-image-2, never a rigid grid port.
prose.rules: Clawd is always friendly. No angel elements ever on this entity (no wings, no halo, no floating heart): those belong to angel-clawd. No accessories in the base hero. Clawd is DRAWN, never prompted: canonical art comes from generators/clawd-master (SVG from a measured grid). An image model may only condition on the generator's approved PNGs.

archived.reason: Anthropic campaign concluded (Gary, 2026-08-15): the plain Anthropic pixel mascot is Claude-branded by identity (base of angel-clawd, campaign merch art). History and locked art stay valid; do not cast in new work.
